identity: Isolated signed test JWT; real WorkOS login not exercised

events.step: 1 · Two independently paired machines; outbound connections, no forwarded ports
2 · Browser dispatches one real Harbor + Docker setup task, with no model calls
3 · Queued work moves to the cloud runner; another browser sees the same active evaluation
4 · Killing the polling daemon does not kill Harbor; results wait safely on disk
5 · Restarting the daemon uploads the existing result once, without rerunning the task
6 · Harbor results arrive as a private report, ready for Studio and sharing
7 · Stop requests wait for the machine’s cleanup acknowledgment
8 · Disconnecting a runner revokes its credential; saved reports remain
